subject: Weekly MAP gatekeeper update — POC acceptance criteria & blockers
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Morales <ethan.morales@nimbus-health.com>, Claire Huang <claire.huang@nimbus-health.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Weekly MAP gatekeeper update — POC acceptance criteria & blockers

Hi Ethan & Claire,

Quick weekly MAP update from our side for the Nimbus POC. Keeping this short with explicit owners so we can close by the end of July per the timeline in the MAP. Highlights and ask at the top:

- Ask: Confirm the acceptance window for the Clinical Search test (see acceptance item 2) by EOD Friday so we can schedule load tests.
- Net timeline: still aiming for pilot acceptance by 2026-07-29; risk if procurement delays or if tokenization edge cases require a hotfix.

Status summary
- Eval plan: on track. We uploaded NI-PoC-Eval-Checklist.pdf to the shared drive (link below). Vanessa has completed the model baseline runs for the demo dataset.
- Acceptance criteria: final draft attached in Nimbus_MAP_v3.xlsx — items 1–5 are stable, item 6 (audit log retention) waiting on procurement decision.
- Blockers: procurement needs legal sign-off for data retention clause; a reproducible search relevance discrepancy seen on a 0.5% subset (Vanessa notes).

Meeting notes (from last sync) — action items follow
- MAP owner: Ben Carter — cadence weekly until acceptance.
- SE lead: Vanessa Ortiz — responsible for test harness and reproduction steps for relevance discrepancy.
- CS lead: Marissa Cole — will coordinate acceptance QA with Claire.
- Procurement touchpoint: Lauren Bishop — to confirm redline timeline with Nimbus procurement.

Action items (owner — due)
1) Procurement redline status update — Lauren — 2026-07-03
2) Confirm Clinical Search acceptance window (3-day window) — Ethan/Claire — 2026-07-03 (EOD)
3) Repro steps + minimized failing set (for relevance discrepancy) — Vanessa — 2026-07-05
4) Run end-to-end acceptance harness and upload results — Vanessa/Marissa — 2026-07-20
5) Run security checklist for private endpoint (KMS proof) — Lauren/Marissa — 2026-07-10

Risks & mitigation
- If procurement redline takes >7 business days, propose a partial acceptance (functional signoff) to avoid slipping the close.
- If the relevance discrepancy persists after the minimized failing set is isolated, we will schedule a deep-dive with applied ML (Marissa to triage).

Next touch: weekly MAP checkpoint meeting — 2026-07-08 @ 10:00 PT (invite sent). Please reply with any schedule conflicts.

Links: https://drive.example.com/file/d/1A2B3C4D/view (MAP v3 & eval checklist), https://hubspot.example.com/deal/DEAL-7381

Thanks,

Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0199

Attachments referenced: Nimbus_MAP_v3.xlsx (MAP v3 with acceptance criteria), NI-PoC-Eval-Checklist.pdf
From: Ethan Morales <ethan.morales@nimbus-health.com>

Cc: Claire Huang <claire.huang@nimbus-health.com>
Date: 2026-07-03T11:06:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Weekly MAP gatekeeper update — POC acceptance criteria & blockers

Ben — thanks for the clear note. Quick responses inline: 

- Procurement: we're chasing legal; I expect a redline by 2026-07-06. If they come back later we can accept the partial functional signoff approach.
- Clinical Search acceptance window: Claire prefers a 4-day window (Mon–Thu) rather than 3 days due to staffing — can we accommodate?
- Relevance discrepancy: Claire logged the failing cases; I've uploaded a small sample to the shared drive under /Nimbus/POC/fail-sample.zip.

We'll aim to confirm the acceptance window by EOD 2026-07-03; if anything slips I'll flag it.

Thanks — Ethan
Director of Product, Nimbus Health
ethan.morales@nimbus-health.com

Team — status on the repro work and test harness: 

- Repro steps: I’ve isolated the failing query pattern to the way Nimbus tokenizes punctuation in longer clinical notes; minimized failing set attached (fail-minimized.json).
- Immediate mitigation: I can push a tokenizer alignment patch to the staging endpoint tomorrow (2026-07-06) and re-run the baseline. That should address ~85% of the mismatches.
- Remaining tasks: generate an acceptance-run script (bash + curl harness) and put results in the drive. ETA for full acceptance harness run: 2026-07-20 as planned.

Action updates (newest first):
- Vanessa — push tokenizer patch to staging — 2026-07-06 (in progress)
- Vanessa/Marissa — acceptance harness script skeleton — 2026-07-09
- Marissa — coordinate QA schedule with Claire — reach out by 2026-07-07

I also added a short troubleshooting doc to the drive: /Nimbus/POC/troubleshooting-tokenization.md

Subject: Re: Weekly MAP gatekeeper update — POC acceptance criteria & blockers

Ethan / Claire — following up from today's MAP checkpoint. Short recap and next steps on procurement: 

- Legal redline: Nimbus legal delivered comments this afternoon (attached redline: Nimbus_redline_v1.docx). I reviewed — most changes are standard, one asks to shorten audit log retention from 12 months to 6 months. Redwood's standard is 12 months for this SKU.
- Proposal: we can offer an interim compromise — 6 months for the trial period, automatically revert to 12 months on full contract execution. Lauren assigned to draft the amendment language by 2026-07-10.

Confirmed timeline items from today's call:
- Clinical Search acceptance window: confirmed 4-day window (Mon–Thu) starting 2026-07-20.
- Tokenizer patch: Vanessa to push to staging on 2026-07-06 (status: done, baseline rerun scheduled).
- Acceptance harness run: 2026-07-20 to 2026-07-23 (results due 2026-07-24).

Please reply if any of the owners above need to change. If everything looks good we'll mark the MAP as "green" for this week and I will update HubSpot with the new timeline and the procurement amendment note.

Thanks,

Lauren Bishop
Senior Manager, Commercial Contracts | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com
